title: A tennis prop market the provider was never asked for is stored, priced and can be graded B (no whitelist by requested market)
steps: PROP_MARKETS.tennis is [] so ingest requests no tennis props (confirmed: ingest.ts line ~101 uses [...GAME_MARKETS, ...PROP_MARKETS[sport]]).
Run evidence/PTEN-001.synthetic.ts (npx tsx from sigmaline) with a synthetic tennis event whose bookmakers return player_aces / player_games_won / player_double_faults.

quotesFromEvent keeps every key matching /^(player_|batter_|pitcher_|goalie_)/ regardless of what was requested; priceMarkets then prices it consensus-only; with 6 books and one book 16% longer, over 7.5 comes out 3.0% B.
expected: Only requested prop keys for the sport are stored; an unrequested/unverified tennis key is dropped (or at least never graded), per "no invented markets".
actual: Rows stored in odds_snapshots with stat player_aces etc., priced as consensus-only, graded B; buildEdges/buildProps have no sport/market whitelist so they would reach Edge Finder and Props tab (labels come out as tidied keys "aces", "games won"). Publishing picks is blocked (publish.ts line 19) but edges_log is not (see PTEN-002). Today the exposure is only if a provider volunteers extra markets.
evidence: evidence/PTEN-001.synthetic.ts output: "prop over 7.5 Carlos Alcaraz player_aces b4 6 3.0% B consensus"
